sources.title: Wonderlab Bio. Off-the-shelf cell therapies without immune rejection.
sources.snippet: Off-the-Shelf Cell Therapies Without Immune Rejection. AI drug discovery needs a human-cell validation foundation. Cell therapy needs HLA-matched allogeneic iPSCs. Wonderlab is the only company with a fully characterized iPSC platform covering 90%+ of the US population, providing the cells both fields require.

sources.title: AiWonderLab
sources.snippet: The AI is the hand; the deciding stays human. We don't count hours — we watch how far a thing reaches. It's craft, not process. The weight is on craft. The model takes the human insight and opens potential roads. Each individual's art is recognising which one syncs with the vision. Made because we wanted to see it exist.
